'''Ianad Cisma''' was a [[Sy Myrthian]] who worked as [[aide]] and consort to the Sy Myrthian [[Senator]] [[Toonbuck Toora]] while she served in the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]].</ref> Cisma stood beside Toora in one of the [[repulsorpod]]s in the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] when [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of the planet [[Naboo]] addressed the Senate to resolve the [[Trade Federation]]'s [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of her [[homeworld]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> While in the Senate Building, Cisma wore a [[Color|black]] [[robe]]. The aide had gray and white skin, red [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ianad Cisma was portrayed by an uncredited extra in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The character was not identified in the film, but received a name in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />
